steps.en: Install the gem, or use a distro package, Homebrew, MacPorts or the Docker image
steps.zh: 安装 gem，或用发行版包、Homebrew、Docker 镜像

steps.en: Write the document in AsciiDoc: attributes plus block markup
steps.zh: 用 AsciiDoc 写文档：属性加块级标记

steps.en: Parses the source into a document model, resolving attributes and cross-references
steps.zh: 把源解析成文档模型，解析属性与交叉引用

steps.en: Convert it, picking the output directory if you want one
steps.zh: 执行转换，需要的话指定输出目录

steps.en: Writes the converted document — HTML5 by default
steps.zh: 写出转换结果，默认 HTML5

value.en: One .adoc source — plain text you can diff — becomes published documentation, with PDF and EPUB a companion converter away
value.zh: 一份可以 diff 的纯文本 .adoc 源变成可发布的文档，PDF 与 EPUB 只差一个配套转换器

sources: README.adoc Installation (gem install asciidoctor, apk add asciidoctor, pacman -S asciidoctor, RVM user-space advice, Docker, Bundler)
README.adoc Usage (asciidoctor --version, 'asciidoctor README.adoc' writes an .html file derived from the source name, asciidoctor -D output README.adoc)
README.adoc intro (parses AsciiDoc into a document model and converts to HTML 5, DocBook 5, manual pages, PDF, EPUB 3; Ruby API, AsciidoctorJ on the JVM, Asciidoctor.js)
README.adoc header attributes (:source-language: ruby, :release-version: 2.0.22) as a real example of the attribute syntax
